Pending/threatened litigation including patent infringement, RICO, product liability; unfavorable outcomes, bonding requirements, non-monetary remedies could materially adversely affect results.

Failure of IT systems, cyber-attacks, data breaches could result in loss of data, disruptions, legal costs, reputational harm.
Decreasing social acceptance of tobacco may impair attracting/retaining skilled workforce needed for Vision.

annual_risk_summary: Primary risks include regulatory/FDA actions, illicit trade, competition from innovative/illicit products, litigation/patent issues, macroeconomic pressures on consumers, supply chain disruptions, asset impairments.
